en:
Um... This is an official announcement
from...uh...what's this place called again?
Huh? What time is it right now? I forgot...

Actually...have I always been alone?
I...forgot that, too.

Ugh...I can't remember... I feel like...I used
to have someone very important to me...
I knew it... He's helpless without me.

<CLT=cltMIND>Alright, time to go to training.
Kaito and Maki should be in the courtyard.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.

<CLT=cltMIND>The bed is starting to feel more comfortable,
I just might prefer it over futons...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>They went through all this just for a
killing game? What is their objective...?
